The result is immediately copied into a 0x200-byte stack buffer before UI_AddNpcMenuEntry at 0x114D4D. A callsite wrapper can therefore append a level-derived price for repeat services without modifying global localization data; server price calculation remains authoritative. Its strict 22-byte signature is unique in build 92777.

entries.name: D2GAME_PACKETCALLBACK_Rcv0x16_PickItemOnGround
entries.notes: Authoritative server callback with observed ABI (game, player, packet, packetSize) -> int32. It requires exactly 17 bytes, reads the target item GUID at packet +1, enumerates room units to resolve that item and reaches the native pickup helper at 0x4BA0EF. PotionAutoPickup hooks this callback, so its minimum_interval_frames counter advances on pickup packets rather than game frames and creates no idle polling. D2MOO supplies semantic ancestry only and uses a legacy 13-byte packet; no address, ABI or packet layout is transposed. Its strict 41-byte prologue is unique in build 92777.

entries.name: UNITS_GetUnitType
entries.notes: Null-checked unit-type getter with observed ABI (unit) -> int32. The non-null path returns dword [unit+0x00]; AITACTICS_SetVelocity calls it twice before resolving monster AI parameters. RogueScoutMovement uses it only after a non-null guard and requires its strict build-92777 prologue.

entries.name: UNITS_GetClassId
entries.notes: Null-checked class-id getter with observed ABI (unit) -> int32. The non-null path returns dword [unit+0x04]. RogueScoutMovement uses class id 271 to isolate roguehire and requires its strict build-92777 prologue.

entries.name: D2GAME_MONSTERMODE_SetVelocityParams
entries.notes: Observed ABI (aiParam, pathType, velocityPercent, distance) -> void. It writes nonzero path type at aiParam+0x20, nonzero velocity percent at +0x24 and a clamped nonzero distance byte at +0x28. A zero velocity argument is a sentinel that normally preserves the previous field; RogueScoutMovement clears +0x24 explicitly only inside a thread-local, aiParam-matched Act I Rogue follow scope so an absolute configured velocity of 11 remains the exact BKVince baseline.

entries.name: D2GAME_PETAI_PetMove
entries.notes: Authoritative pet movement helper with observed x64 ABI (game, owner, unit, motionType, run, velocityPercent, steps) -> int32. The 49-byte wildcard signature is unique in build 92777 and its four direct callers are 0x5BEC72, 0x5BECA1, 0x5BEFCD and 0x5BF00A. D2MOO provides semantic ancestry: Hireable uses motion 0 for near following and motion 1 for catch-up, while later motion values cover wander, warp and spacing. RogueScoutMovement hooks only motion 0/1 after unit type, class 271 and room-town checks.

entries.name: D2GAME_ITEMS_RollItemQuality
entries.notes: Authoritative server item-quality roll with observed x64 ABI (game, monsterOrSeedUnit, playerOrKiller, itemLevel, itemId, tcQualityMods) -> int32 quality and one direct caller at 0x440FD9. It reads stat 80 from the player or monster and adds the minion owner's value, preserves a separate MF<=-100 gate, applies diminishing returns to unique/set/rare, leaves magic linear, then applies ItemRatio minima, Treasure Class modifiers and native RNG. Its strict 38-byte prologue is unique in build 92777.

entries.name: MagicFindUniqueDiminishingGate
entries.notes: Two-byte JG +4 (7F 04) selecting the positive unique-quality diminishing formula after CMP (MF+100),110. The 15-byte witness at 0x4423CA is unique and includes constant 250. Replacing only this branch with two NOPs selects the existing linear ECX=MF+100 path without changing negative MF, ItemRatio, Treasure Class or RNG behavior.

entries.name: MagicFindSetDiminishingGate
entries.notes: Two-byte JG +4 (7F 04) selecting the positive set-quality diminishing formula after CMP (MF+100),110. The 15-byte witness at 0x442467 is unique and includes constant 500. Replacing only this branch with two NOPs selects the existing linear ECX=MF+100 path while preserving all surrounding quality-roll policy.

entries.name: MagicFindRareDiminishingGate
entries.notes: Two-byte JG +4 (7F 04) selecting the positive rare-quality diminishing formula after CMP (MF+100),110. The 15-byte witness at 0x4424F4 is unique and includes constant 600. Replacing only this branch with two NOPs selects the existing linear ECX=MF+100 path; the magic-quality block at 0x442576 remains native and already linear.

entries.name: HDItems_ResolveBaseItemAsset
entries.notes: Resolves a base-item HD asset for unit type 4. It obtains the ItemsTxt record, reads the complete packed dword code at record +0x80 and binary-searches the 64-byte base-item asset registry entries owned by the manager at +0xD8. This full-width lookup proves the runtime resolver itself accepts four significant code bytes in build 92777.

entries.name: HDItems_LoadBaseItemAssetsJson
entries.notes: Initializes and fills the base-item HD asset registry from items.json. Its key-copy block at 0x6639D5 is the only build-92777 truncation found after the TXT compiler, full-dword item lookup, save encoding and runtime asset resolver were audited.

entries.name: HDItemsJsonCodePaddingBlock
entries.notes: Unique 26-byte code-padding block inside HDItems_LoadBaseItemAssetsJson. Vanilla reads key byte 2, pads it when absent, then unconditionally stores ASCII space as byte 3 (0F B6 46 02 84 C0 75 09 66 C7 44 24 26 20 20 EB 09 88 44 24 26 C6 44 24 27 20). The Four Character Item Codes memory patch replaces the block in place with two symmetric byte reads and NUL-to-space fallbacks. The replacement is exactly 26 bytes, reaches the original 0x663A19 continuation without a relay, and preserves one-, two-, and three-character behavior.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_ExecuteEvents
entries.notes: Confirmed-static authoritative damage/event commit with logical bounds 0x44CE80..0x44D569 and ABI (game, attacker, defender, bMissile, D2Damage*) -> void. Its 31-byte entry signature is unique and it has 36 direct callers. Melee callsite 0x44B3FA passes bMissile=0 while missile callsite 0x436F95 passes 1, so this is a shared commit surface rather than an exclusively-melee hit seam.

entries.name: D2GAME_EventFunc14_ItemFreeze
entries.notes: Confirmed-static EventFunc14 ItemFreeze callback. Its strict 32-byte entry signature is unique in build 92777; zero direct xrefs are expected because the native dispatcher calls handlers indirectly. The D2R callback frame transports nine positions, not a seven-argument ABI copied from legacy D2MOO.

entries.name: D2GAME_EventFunc20_SkillOnAttackHitKill
entries.notes: Confirmed-static EventFunc20 callback for skill-on-attack/hit/kill nodes. Its strict 33-byte entry signature is unique; packed node payload uses high-word stat id and low-word layer before the layered stat getter. The ItemTgtDo branch at 0x583C50 requires a unit target and otherwise returns success without casting; with a target it calls SKILLITEM_CastOnTarget(target, skill, level, target, 0). The ordinary branch calls SKILLITEM_CastOnTarget(source, skill, level, target, 1), or obtains first-point Y/X through 0x34B940/0x34B8F0 and calls SKILLITEM_CastAtPosition when no unit target exists. Dispatch is indirect with a nine-position D2R frame, so zero direct xrefs do not imply an unused handler.

entries.name: SUNIT_CanDamageTarget
entries.notes: Confirmed-static server target-permission predicate with logical bounds 0x48E060..0x48E248 and ABI (game, attacker, candidate) -> int32. Its 19-byte entry signature is unique; direct callers 0x44CEC1 and 0x44A9C9 prove its role before damage commit and finalization. It resolves owners/minions, town, rooms and hostile relation but does not prove distance or LOS.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_FillDamageValues
entries.notes: Confirmed-static native damage builder with bounds 0x44C030..0x44CDC8 and ABI (game, attacker, defender, D2Damage*, mode, SrcDam) -> void. Its unique 30-byte signature and eight callers are governed. The mode-zero path resolves weapon-mastery Critical, passive Critical Strike, then Deadly Strike with short-circuiting; success doubles physical and sets the shared result bit 0x2000.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_ApplyDamageBonuses
entries.notes: Confirmed-static eight-argument native damage-bonus helper with bounds 0x44D710..0x44D9E5 and ABI (attacker, getStats, item, minDamage, maxDamage, enhancedPct, flatDamage, SrcDam) -> int32. Its 31-byte signature is unique with six callers and nine material callees. This proof establishes the generic helper only; it does not validate the prototype's historical Smite composition.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_ApplyMonsterCritical
entries.notes: Confirmed-static monster-critical stage with bounds 0x5889E0..0x588AF4, unique 32-byte signature and ABI (attacker, defender, D2Damage*) -> void. It rolls the attacker seed against MonStats chance and doubles six damage components. It does not set the player Critical/Deadly result bit 0x2000 and is therefore a distinct result path.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_CalculateTotalDamage
entries.notes: Confirmed-static component-aware damage resolver with bounds 0x44DF10..0x44ECE0 and ABI (game, attacker, defender, D2Damage*) -> void. Its 49-byte signature is unique with four callers. It applies resistances, reductions, absorb and final totals and delegates to the governed resistance resolver 0x4523E0.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_FinalizeDamage
entries.notes: Confirmed-static final damage/status/mode/death stage with bounds 0x44A9B0..0x44B2A2, unique 30-byte signature and ABI (game, attacker, defender, D2Damage*) -> void. It has 32 direct callers and follows ExecuteEvents on the governed melee and missile chains. Runtime ordering of reactions, death and packets remains a MEC-01 witness.

entries.name: D2Damage_CopyConstructor
entries.notes: Confirmed-static deep-copy constructor with bounds 0x4494B0..0x4496DF, unique 32-byte signature and ABI (destination, source) -> destination for the build-92777 0x180-byte D2Damage object. It copies scalars, reconstructs the internal SBO container and constructs the owned subobject at +0x158.

entries.name: D2Damage_MoveConstructor
entries.notes: Confirmed-static move constructor with unique 33-byte signature, four direct xrefs and ABI (destination, source) -> destination for the build-92777 0x180-byte D2Damage object. The combat-record linker calls it at 0x450908 after copying the source damage to a stack temporary, so external pointer provenance must transfer from that temporary to the node damage object.

entries.name: D2Damage_Destructor
entries.notes: Confirmed-static destructor with bounds 0x4496E0..0x449752, unique 32-byte signature and ABI (D2Damage*) -> void for the 0x180-byte record. It destroys the owned subobject at +0x158 and releases the +0x40 container only when it is outside the inline SBO storage.

entries.name: D2GAME_EventFunc15_OpenWounds
entries.notes: Confirmed-static Open Wounds event callback with bounds 0x584170..0x584316 and unique 24-byte signature. The native nine-position callback frame supplies game, event, attacker, target and packed layered-stat payload. It rolls the attacker seed, computes the native OW value and delegates state 62 to the generic curse/statlist helper; the exact BSS tuple for duration/stat id still requires a runtime read-only witness.

entries.name: D2GAME_EventFunc16_CrushingBlow
entries.notes: Confirmed-static Crushing Blow event callback with bounds 0x583150..0x583276 and unique 32-byte signature. It consumes the D2Damage pointer and packed chance from the native nine-position callback frame, rolls the attacker seed, builds the target-class divisor context and calls the native Crushing Blow core at 0x581BD0.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_ApplyLifeAndManaLeech
entries.notes: Confirmed-static unique life/mana leech consumer with bounds 0x450C90..0x451380, unique 32-byte signature and ABI (game, attacker, defender, D2Damage*) -> void. Its only direct caller is ExecuteEvents at 0x44D038. It consumes raw percentages at D2Damage+0x120/+0x124, applies Drain and difficulty divisors, and rewrites those fields with native-adjusted percentages. It then derives and caps the separately credited life/mana amounts; the rewritten fields are not direct witnesses of the credited amounts.

entries.name: D2GAME_DispatchUnitStatEventList
entries.notes: Confirmed-static native unit-stat event-list dispatcher with bounds 0x5881E0..0x58844B and unique 16-byte signature. Eight direct callers include the damage-event wrapper at 0x44D5F2. It walks attacker+0xE0, invokes node callbacks through a nine-position D2R frame and safely performs deferred deletion after callback return.

entries.name: D2GAME_ApplyCrushingBlowCore
entries.notes: Confirmed-static Crushing Blow core with bounds 0x581BD0..0x581EC7, unique 24-byte signature and ABI (game, attacker, target, context) -> int32. Its two callers are 0x51D950 and EventFunc16 at 0x583257. It selects target divisors, applies player-count and physical resistance, writes HP, sets D2Damage result bit 2 on lethal damage and applies overlay 147 when positive.

entries.name: D2GAME_ApplyCurseStateStatList
entries.notes: Confirmed-static generic curse/state statlist applicator with bounds 0x433D20..0x4341DC, unique 24-byte signature and 32 callers including Open Wounds. It validates state/target, refreshes matching lists, rejects weaker replacements, unlinks mismatches, allocates and posts new lists, schedules expiration event 12 and installs a remove callback. It is generic and must not be named as an Open-Wounds-only primitive.

entries.name: D2GAME_DefaultCurseStateRemoveCallback
entries.notes: Confirmed-static default curse/state removal callback with bounds 0x436240..0x4362DC and unique 24-byte signature. It unregisters the pending event, preserves dead/stay-death handling, disables the state and refreshes animation, passives and player state as required. It is shared by generic state lists and is not Open-Wounds-exclusive.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_PrepareAndQueueCombatRecord
entries.notes: Confirmed-static combat-record preparation wrapper with logical bounds 0x44B600..0x44B71B, a unique 33-byte signature, 31 direct callers and ABI (game, attacker, defender, D2Damage*, SrcDam:uint8) -> void. It conditionally runs FillDamageValues, runs CalculateTotalDamage, derives WILLDIE and calls the unique combat-node linker at 0x44B703. It prepares target-specific state and is not a safe secondary-damage primitive.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_AllocateAndLinkCombatRecord
entries.notes: Confirmed-static combat-node allocator/linker with logical bounds 0x4507B0..0x4509A3, unique 32-byte signature and ABI (game, attacker, defender, const D2Damage*) -> void. Its only direct caller is 0x44B703. It allocates 0x1A0 bytes, records attacker/defender type and GUID, deep-copies D2Damage to node+0x18 and links the node under attacker+0x108; it applies no HP or reactions.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_ConsumeMeleeCombatRecord
entries.notes: Confirmed-static stored-melee-combat consumer with logical bounds 0x44B2B0..0x44B5F5, unique 34-byte signature, 36 direct callers and ABI (game, attacker, defender, rangeBonus) -> bool/uint8. It finds the node by type/GUID, deep-copies its D2Damage, validates range, calls ExecuteEvents with bMissile=0, performs additional melee events/durability/thorns work, calls FinalizeDamage and unlinks/frees the node. Its breadth makes it unsafe as a blind splash-target primitive.

entries.name: D2GAME_EnumerateUnitsInArea
entries.notes: Confirmed-static area-enumeration core with logical bounds 0x4398B0..0x439C04, unique 18-byte signature and eight direct callers. Its ten-position ABI carries game, origin, room/x/y descriptor, radius, mask, callback, user context, a special monster filter and source provenance. It walks the supplied room array and each room unit list in native order, applies square and inclusive radius gates and invokes callback(ctx,candidate). MEC-W07 remains partial because the upstream room-list membership and uniqueness/dedup invariants are not yet proven.

entries.name: DUNGEON_GetRoomListAndCount
entries.notes: Confirmed-static room-list accessor with bounds 0x2EFDE0..0x2EFDED, unique 13-byte body and ABI (room, roomListOut, roomCountOut) -> void. It returns room+0 and the count at room+0x40. Its use by the area enumerator is proven, but the exact adjacent-room membership is not promoted until the native writer/builder is identified.

entries.name: DUNGEON_GetFirstUnitInRoom
entries.notes: Confirmed-static one-argument room-unit-list accessor with bounds 0x2EFD90..0x2EFD98 and unique 8-byte body. It returns the pointer at room+0xA8 and is used by the governed area-enumeration traversal.

entries.name: UNITS_GetNextUnitInRoom
entries.notes: Confirmed-static room-list next-unit accessor with logical bounds 0x34B4A0..0x34B4DB and a unique strict 46-byte signature. It returns unit+0x160; the area enumerator reads this next pointer before filters and callback invocation.

entries.name: DUNGEON_DoesRoomIntersectSearchSquare
entries.notes: Confirmed-static inclusive broad-phase test with bounds 0x3256E0..0x325760 and unique 30-byte signature. ABI (room, centerX, centerY, radius) -> bool compares the search square against the room rectangle before per-unit traversal.

entries.name: COORDS_GetSquaredDistance
entries.notes: Confirmed-static squared-distance helper with bounds 0x3412C0..0x3412D3 and unique 19-byte body. ABI (x1, y1, x2, y2) -> int32 computes (x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2; the area enumerator accepts candidates when this value is less than or equal to radius squared.

entries.name: D2GAME_EventFunc7_Knockback
entries.notes: Confirmed-static EventFunc7 Knockback handler with logical bounds 0x583E00..0x583F0F, a unique 30-byte entry signature and the governed nine-position event callback ABI. It has zero direct xrefs because the 92777 event-list dispatcher invokes callbacks indirectly. MeleeSplash filters this handler only while its thread-local synthetic-secondary guard is active.

entries.name: D2GAME_EventFunc9_Blind
entries.notes: Confirmed-static EventFunc9 Blind handler with logical bounds 0x583400..0x58357B, a unique 30-byte entry signature and the governed nine-position event callback ABI. It has zero direct xrefs because dispatch is indirect. MeleeSplash filters it only for synthetic secondary resolution.

entries.name: D2GAME_EventFunc19_Slow
entries.notes: Confirmed-static EventFunc19 Slow handler with logical bounds 0x5849D0..0x584B56, a unique 33-byte entry signature and the governed nine-position event callback ABI. It has zero direct xrefs because dispatch is indirect. MeleeSplash filters it only for synthetic secondary resolution.

entries.name: D2GAME_EventFunc21_SkillOnGetHit
entries.notes: Confirmed-static EventFunc21 SkillOnGetHit handler with logical bounds 0x5837F0..0x583995, a unique 31-byte entry signature and the governed nine-position event callback ABI. It has zero direct xrefs because dispatch is indirect. MeleeSplash filters it only for synthetic secondary resolution.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_PreCriticalApplyDamageBonusesCall
entries.notes: Confirmed-static call inside SUNITDMG_FillDamageValues to 0x44D710 ApplyDamageBonuses. The five bytes E8 5F 14 00 00 and unique 21-byte context are governed. Its continuation at 0x44C2B1 stores EAX to D2Damage+0x18 immediately before the native mode-gated Critical/Deadly sequence.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_PreEvent3ApplyDamageEventCall
entries.notes: Confirmed-static conditional Event 3 call inside SUNITDMG_FillDamageValues. The five bytes E8 CD 09 00 00 and unique 34-byte context from 0x44CB89 are governed. ABI is int32(game, event, defender, attacker, D2Damage*), with continuation 0x44CBA3.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_DirectMeleeFillDamageValuesCall
entries.notes: Confirmed-static direct melee call to SUNITDMG_FillDamageValues with continuation 0x4300BB. Its unique 29-byte context begins at 0x43009E. The same stack D2Damage at caller rsp+0x70 then passes through 0x56CBE0 and into SUNITDMG_PrepareAndQueueCombatRecord at 0x4300DE with hit flag 0x02, so the wrapper skips a second Fill and continues through canonical Calculate, Allocate and Consume. A 2026-08-09 runtime witness with normal Attack confirmed capture at return 0x4300BB and a three-target synthetic burst.

entries.name: SEED_RollPowerOfTwo
entries.notes: Exact 35-byte leaf routine advancing the supplied native seed and returning nextLow & (upperBound - 1). The Rare generator calls it at 0x58BC98 with upperBound 8. ProgressiveAffixesPlugin validates it and uses it only for semantic vanilla fallback.

entries.name: D2GAME_ITEMS_GenerateCraftedAffixes
entries.notes: Build-92777 Crafted affix generator with observed ABI (item, generation) -> int32. The governed block reads item level at generation+0x18, computes minima at ilvl 1/31/51/71, rolls 0..4 through 0x153B00, then applies the selected count through native prefix/suffix selection and finalization.

entries.name: CraftedAffixCountRollCall
entries.notes: Exact five-byte call E8 E0 98 BC FF to SEED_RollLimitedRandomNumber inside the Crafted generator. ProgressiveAffixesPlugin redirects it through a near relay receiving the existing seed in RCX, item in R15 and generation in R12.

entries.name: CraftedAffixVanillaMinimumClamp
entries.notes: Five-byte CMP/CMOVA sequence 3B D8 0F 47 C3 that clamps the Crafted RNG result to the vanilla ilvl minimum. ProgressiveAffixesPlugin NOPs it only after its relay has selected the complete configured 1..4 count.

entries.name: D2GAME_ITEMS_GenerateRareAffixes
entries.notes: Build-92777 Rare affix generator with observed ABI (item, generation) -> int32. It resolves existing affix state, obtains the native item seed, selects a 3..4 jewel count or regular eight-entry count, then uses native prefix/suffix selection with three-per-side limits and finalization.

entries.name: RareJewelAffixCountBranch
entries.notes: Two-byte JNE +0x29 separating the native jewel 3..4 LCG path from the regular Rare table path. ProgressiveAffixesPlugin changes it to JMP so jewels and regular items reach one configured selector while still consuming exactly one seed step.

entries.name: RareAffixCountSelectionBlock
entries.notes: Exact 30-byte block 0x58BC90..0x58BCAD loading bound 8, rolling the item seed and mapping the index through the native count table. ProgressiveAffixesPlugin replaces the full block with a rel32 call, moves EAX to R12D, restores R9=seed and rejoins the untouched loop at 0x58BCAE.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_WeaponMasteryCriticalChanceCall
entries.notes: Exact five-byte call E8 18 12 EF FF inside SUNITDMG_FillDamageValues to the weapon-mastery Critical chance helper. The governed context supplies attacker, active weapon, argument3=0 and argument4=2; BKVCombat preserves that callee ABI and caps only the returned chance when its Critical policy is operational.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_PassiveCriticalChanceCall
entries.notes: Exact five-byte call E8 F0 8C EA FF inside SUNITDMG_FillDamageValues to STATLIST_GetUnitStat for passive_critical_strike stat 337, layer 0. It is reached only after the weapon-mastery Critical branch fails and retains the native (unit, statId, layer) -> int32 ABI.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_DeadlyStrikeChanceCall
entries.notes: Exact five-byte call E8 DC 98 EA FF inside SUNITDMG_FillDamageValues to STATLIST_UnitGetStatValue for item_deadlystrike stat 141, layer 0. It is reached only after both Critical branches fail and retains the native layered-stat ABI.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_DeadlyStrikeSuccessTail
entries.notes: Exact 17-byte native success tail 8B 47 18 03 C0 89 47 18 B8 00 20 00 00 66 09 47 04. The unique branch context at 0x44C3C2 distinguishes the Deadly-success path from Critical success; BKVCombat redirects this block and rejoins at 0x44C3D9 so only Deadly uses the configured 1.5x multiplier.

entries.name: D2GAME_EventFunc16_CrushingBlowCoreCall
entries.notes: Exact five-byte call E8 74 E9 FF FF from EventFunc16 to D2GAME_ApplyCrushingBlowCore at 0x581BD0. The preserved x64 ABI is int32(game, attacker, target, context); the int32 return is authoritative and EventFunc16 itself remains owned by MeleeSplash in the supported stack.

entries.name: D2GAME_EventFunc15_OpenWoundsStatListCall
entries.notes: Exact five-byte call E8 28 FA EA FF from EventFunc15 to D2GAME_ApplyCurseStateStatList at 0x433D20. ABI is StatList* (ApplyArgs*), where the 0x30-byte argument record carries source, target, skill, duration, stat, state and optional removal callback; EventFunc15 itself remains owned by MeleeSplash.

entries.name: D2GAME_EventFunc05_LifeTap
entries.notes: Confirmed-static Life Tap handler with logical bounds 0x55BCD0..0x55BFAC and a validated 32-byte entry signature. It uses the native event-callback frame and derives a separate life credit from resolved physical damage; it is not ordinary stat-60 life steal and BKVCombat validates but never hooks it.

entries.name: D2GAME_GetMinionOwner
entries.notes: Confirmed-static monster-minion owner resolver with logical bounds 0x4A53C0..0x4A547C, validated 32-byte entry signature and ABI Unit* (Unit* monster). It validates unit type, reads the monster owner identity and re-resolves that owner through SUNIT_GetServerUnit; null is returned when no live owner is available.

entries.name: UNITS_GetGame
entries.notes: Confirmed-static unit-to-game accessor with logical bounds 0x48FF00..0x48FF3A, validated 32-byte entry signature and ABI Game* (Unit*). For a valid unit it returns the pointer at unit+0xD8; BKVCombat uses it transiently while creating server-owned Open Wounds stat lists. Burn Damage Fix fingerprints the same entry and obtains the authoritative game from the attacker, or the defender when no attacker exists, before native Fire resolution.

entries.name: STATLIST_GetStatListFromUnitAndState
entries.notes: Confirmed-static state-list lookup with validated entry signature and ABI StatList* (Unit*, int32 state). The Open Wounds lifecycle uses it to detect state 62 before disabling that state in the custom removal callback.

entries.name: STATLIST_AllocStatList
entries.notes: Confirmed-static stat-list allocator with validated 32-byte entry signature and ABI StatList* (uint32 flags, int32 expireFrame, int32 sourceType, uint32 sourceGuid). BKVCombat uses only the governed Open Wounds flags and immediately frees any partially initialized list on validation failure.

entries.name: STATLIST_SetStatListState
entries.notes: Exact nine-byte leaf setter 48 85 C9 74 03 89 51 20 C3 with ABI void (StatList*, int32 state). It stores the state at StatList+0x20 and is null-safe.

entries.name: STATLIST_SetStatListSkillId
entries.notes: Confirmed-static stat-list skill-ID setter with bounds 0x2F79B0..0x2F79F2, validated 32-byte signature and ABI void (StatList*, int32 skillId). It stores the value at StatList+0x28.

entries.name: STATLIST_SetStatListSkillLevel
entries.notes: Confirmed-static stat-list skill-level setter with bounds 0x2F7A00..0x2F7A42, validated 32-byte signature and ABI void (StatList*, int32 skillLevel). It stores the value at StatList+0x2C.

entries.name: STATLIST_SetStatListStat
entries.notes: Confirmed-static stat-list stat setter with bounds 0x2F7C00..0x2F7C14, validated 21-byte signature and ABI void (uint8 dataContext, StatList*, int32 statId, int32 value, uint16 layer). It tail-calls the native stat insertion primitive and is used for the negative stat-74 Open Wounds rate.

entries.name: STATLIST_SetStatListRemoveCallback
entries.notes: Exact 13-byte leaf setter 48 85 C9 74 07 48 89 91 80 00 00 00 C3 with ABI void (StatList*, RemoveCallback). It stores the callback at StatList+0x80 and is null-safe.

entries.name: STATLIST_SetStatListExpireFrame
entries.notes: Exact expire-frame setter with bounds 0x2F7AB0..0x2F7AC9 and validated 26-byte signature. ABI is void (StatList*, int32 frame); a positive frame sets list flag 0x2 and stores the frame as float at StatList+0x24.

entries.name: STATLIST_PostStatList
entries.notes: Confirmed-static stat-list posting primitive with validated 32-byte entry signature and ABI void (Unit* target, StatList*, int32 update). It links the list under the target's extended stat-list owner and updates the unit aggregate.

entries.name: STATLIST_UnlinkStatList
entries.notes: Confirmed-static unlink wrapper with bounds 0x2F7920..0x2F7939, validated 26-byte signature and ABI void (Unit* target, StatList*). It derives the target data context before tail-calling the internal unlink primitive.

entries.name: STATLIST_FreeStatList
entries.notes: Exact 16-byte stat-list free wrapper with bounds 0x2F4180..0x2F418F and ABI void (uint8 dataContext, StatList*). BKVCombat calls it only for a newly allocated unposted list or after explicit unlink, providing fail-closed rollback after allocation or post-validation failure.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_ApplyLifeAndManaLeechCall
entries.notes: Exact five-byte call E8 53 3C 00 00 from SUNITDMG_ExecuteEvents to the unique leech consumer at 0x450C90. The governed context starts at 0x44D02C and preserves ABI void (game, attacker, defender, D2Damage*); BKVCombat validates this baseline but installs no leech hook.

entries.name: SOUNDENVIRON_GetRecord
entries.notes: Receives the sound-environment index in ECX, resolves data context 3, reads the compiled row count at DataTables+0x508 and returns the indexed record only when 0 <= index < count. An index equal to the count reaches the native assertion at 0x3B0C82. This proves that deleting stable row 75 while the Terror Zone resolver can still request index 75 is invalid.

entries.name: InheritedSoundEnvironmentSongStore
entries.notes: Unique six-byte store 89 05 1F B5 88 02 in build 92777. It copies only the inherited sound-environment Song field loaded from record+0x34 into the active environment. NOPing this store preserves the base area's current music while leaving the ten adjacent inherited ambience and event assignments native.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_MainHitpointsCommitCall
entries.notes: Exact five-byte call E8 78 AC EA FF from SUNITDMG_ExecuteEvents to STATLIST_SetUnitStat for the main target HP mutation. The unique 21-byte context begins at 0x44D083 and passes defender, stat 6, the post-damage fixed-point HP and layer 0; R14 and RDI still hold attacker and D2Damage. FloatingDamage 1.2.1 redirects only this call through a private near relay, invokes the original setter with unchanged arguments, and reports the visible old/new HP delta. Runtime proved fixed 169472->168480 yields popup 4.

entries.name: MONSTERUNIQUE_UMod30_AuraEnchanted
entries.notes: Exact build-92777 Aura Enchanted callback reached through index 30 of the 43-entry MonUMod dispatcher at RVA 0x2395FE0. Its unique 32-byte entry signature is 40 55 53 57 48 8B EC 48 83 EC 70 41 8B D8 48 8B F9 48 85 C9 74 0A E8 E5 5C EB FF 83 F8 01 74 1B. The ordinary path reads monster stat level 12, selects from weighted 0x18-byte aura records, computes multiplier*(level+offset)/divisor, clamps it and assigns the selected skill. BKVince redirects only that ordinary pool to eight monster-only records, changes the upper clamp from 99 to 13 and keeps the native Uber Mephisto level-20 branch.

entries.name: MONSTERUNIQUE_UModInitCallbacks
entries.notes: Runtime-initialized table of 43 absolute x64 callback pointers. Its non-null mask exactly matches MonUMod indices 1,2,4,5,6,8,9,16,17,18,23,25,26,27,28,30,36,37,38,39,41; index 30 resolves to RVA 0x495CD0. The mapping was recovered independently from a full-stack build-92777 process; D2MOO supplies semantic names only.

entries.name: AITHINK_NormalAiTable
entries.notes: Static normal monster-AI table selected only by AITHINK_GetAiTableRecord. The resolver has two RIP-relative references to this base at 0x4A379F and fallback 0x4A37B9, accepts exactly 155 indices and uses 0x20-byte x64 records. Its occupied range [0x2396E90,0x23981F0) ends exactly where the special-state AI table begins; no in-place append slot exists.

entries.name: MONSTERUNIQUE_VanillaAuraEnchantedRecords
entries.notes: Runtime-initialized vanilla Aura Enchanted array of seven 0x18-byte records with fields minLevel, weight, levelOffset, multiplier, divisor and skillId. The original skill IDs are 98,368,108,365,123,122,369 with divisors 6,6,5,7,8,8,8 and Holy Shock minimum level 20. The distinct four-record table beginning at 0x1D1DF20 overlaps what would have been an eighth 0x18-byte slot, so BKVince relocates its exact eight-record pool to verified padding instead of overwriting adjacent native data.

entries.name: TREASURECLASS_GenerateDrops
entries.notes: Server Treasure Class drop entry called directly at 0x40BB3E, 0x415C21 and 0x447E17. The governed Windows x64 ABI has ten arguments: R8 is a player or monster killer Unit*, R9W is a scalar Treasure Class id, and arguments 5-10 occupy caller stack slots. The entry begins 40 53 55 56 57 41 54 41 55 41 56 41 57. A wrapper must forward all ten arguments unchanged; a monster killer can be normalized through D2GAME_GetMinionOwner 0x4A53C0.

entries.name: UI_CanQuickMoveItemToAdvancedStash
entries.notes: Native Advanced Stash eligibility predicate with observed ABI bool (item). It first requires stash UI state 0x18, validates the local client context, resolves UNITS_GetClassId and queries UI_HasAdvancedStashRegistrationForItemClass at 0x15F320. Both legacy and modern inventory Ctrl-click handlers call it before routing to UI_QuickMoveItemToAdvancedStash. Its strict 32-byte entry signature is unique in the governed build-92777 corpus reused for current D2R 3.3.93847.

entries.name: UI_HasAdvancedStashRegistrationForItemClass
entries.notes: Receives an item class id in ECX, searches the runtime hash-map chain rooted at the Advanced Stash registry and returns true when the class key is present. UI_CanQuickMoveItemToAdvancedStash is the proven caller. The lookup behavior is static-proof; the exact ownership and compiler path of the backing registry remain to be promoted after runtime validation.

entries.name: UI_IsItemInteractionBlocked
entries.notes: Native item-interaction gate with observed ABI int (item). It returns one when the item has the queried mode-2 stat-list condition or when the local player has state 0x36, and zero otherwise. UI_QuickMoveItemToAdvancedStash requires zero before transferring. Its strict 32-byte entry signature is unique in the governed corpus.

entries.name: CLIENT_GetAdvancedStashDestination
entries.notes: Receives the local player, obtains its inventory and traverses the auxiliary corpse-linked records until the two native predicates select the destination used by Advanced Stash quick move. UI_QuickMoveItemToAdvancedStash passes the returned pointer directly as the destination argument to CLIENT_TransferItemToInventoryPage. The strict 32-byte entry signature is unique in the governed corpus.

entries.name: UI_QuickMoveItemToAdvancedStash
entries.notes: Native Advanced Stash widget action. It resolves the item through widget vtable +0xC8, requires UI_IsItemInteractionBlocked to return zero, resolves the local player and CLIENT_GetAdvancedStashDestination, reads the source page and calls CLIENT_TransferItemToInventoryPage at 0x15F8B0 with destination page 4 and transfer mode 1, then finishes the inventory interaction at 0x1A0780. Legacy and modern inventory Ctrl-click handlers dispatch here only after the 0x15A0B0 eligibility predicate succeeds.

entries.name: UI_FinishInventoryInteraction
entries.notes: Called by UI_QuickMoveItemToAdvancedStash after every attempted transfer with arguments (3, null, 0, 0, false). Currency Stash Deposit reproduces that exact call on D2R's UI thread after invoking CLIENT_TransferItemToInventoryPage. The role name reflects the observed call context; broader semantics remain unclaimed. Its strict 32-byte entry signature is unique in the governed corpus.

entries.name: DATATBLS_GetLevelDefRecord
entries.notes: Returns the 0x9C-byte Levels record for the requested data context and LevelId with observed ABI (uint8 dataContext, int32 levelId) -> LevelDef*. It validates the data-context table and row bounds, returns null on failure and exposes the native automap Layer at record+0x08. The standard automap callback 0xD2240 passes that value to AUTOMAP_GetOrCreateLayer. Its strict 32-byte entry signature is unique in the governed common corpus.

entries.name: COORD_ConvertGameTileToAutomap
entries.notes: In-place integer conversion with observed ABI (int32* tileX, int32* tileY) -> void. It computes X=80*(tileX-tileY) and Y=40*(tileX+tileY); AUTOMAP_BuildTileCell then divides both by ten before inserting the cell, yielding the persisted automap basis (tileX-tileY)*8 and (tileX+tileY)*4. Its strict 32-byte body is unique in the governed common corpus.

entries.name: AUTOMAP_InsertCell
entries.notes: Native deduplicating tree insertion with observed ABI (AutomapCellTree*, InsertResult*, const AutomapCellKey*) -> InsertResult*. The key is 12 bytes {uint16 tag, int16 frame, int32 x, int32 y}. A missing key allocates one 0x30-byte node through D2R's allocator, copies the payload to node+0x20, increments tree+0x20 and balances through 0xA8EF0; an existing key allocates nothing. The comparator ignores tag and orders by Y, X and frame. D2R's sidecar loader calls this function with tag 1 at 0xD5C6F. Its strict 32-byte entry signature is unique.

entries.name: AUTOMAP_FindCellInsertionPoint
entries.notes: Searches an automap cell tree with observed ABI (AutomapCellTree*, FindResult*, const AutomapCellKey*) -> FindResult*. FindResult is 16 bytes {node, insertionSlot}: insertionSlot is null for an existing key and otherwise points to the parent child-link where AUTOMAP_InsertCell will allocate. Ordering compares Y at key+0x08, X at +0x04 and then the signed frame at +0x02 through D2R's native frame-priority table. Its only direct caller is 0xD1460 and its strict 32-byte entry signature is unique. MapSense uses this exact preflight to let duplicates pass without mutation even when the tree's total node count is large.

entries.name: AUTOMAP_BuildTileCell
entries.notes: Builds one native automap floor or wall cell with observed ABI (uint8 dataContext, TileRecord*, DrlgRoom*, AutomapCellTree*) -> void. It sets tile flag bit 18 once, resolves the automap frame, adds the room origin to tile coordinates, applies COORD_ConvertGameTileToAutomap and the native divide-by-ten, adds 24 to Y for orientations >=0x10, then calls AUTOMAP_InsertCell. Its strict 32-byte entry signature is unique.

entries.name: AUTOMAP_GetOrCreateLayer
entries.notes: Returns the native owner for one Levels.Layer id, creating a 0xB0-byte owner when absent. The owner contains four 0x28-byte cell trees at +0x08, +0x30, +0x58 and +0x80 and a linked-list pointer at +0xA8. A foreign target enters the 0xD1710 layer-switch path, which serializes the current trees through 0xD6230 and frees their nodes through 0xD4D60 before changing the owner. MapSense therefore treats this function as a byte witness only and never calls it. Its strict 32-byte entry signature is unique.

entries.name: AUTOMAP_SerializeLayerOwner
entries.notes: Serializes the currently active automap layer owner during the native 0xD1710 layer-switch path and delegates its cell trees to AUTOMAP_SerializeCellTree 0xD7CE0 before their nodes are freed. The 2026-09-01 MapSense transition crash occurred inside this path before the Act III owner could be replaced.

entries.name: AUTOMAP_SerializeCellTree
entries.notes: Walks one native automap cell tree but skips a node when the first byte of its key at node+0x20 is nonzero. Each emitted zero-tag key contributes three uint16 values (frame, X and Y), exactly six bytes. Its exact epilogue witness at 0xD7E3F doubles the output container's uint16 element count and sign-extends it; therefore the safe bound is 5461 emitted zero-tag records, not 5461 total tree nodes. The crash witness RBP=0xFFFFB118 corresponds exactly to 7556 emitted MapSense keys * 6 = 45336 = 0xB118 and was later consumed as an oversized copy length.

entries.name: AUTOMAP_SerializeCellTree_SignedByteCountWitness
entries.notes: Exact unique 13-byte serializer epilogue (0F B7 4E 08 66 03 C9 0F BF C9 41 89 0F). It reads the output container's uint16 emitted-element count at +0x08, doubles it in 16 bits and sign-extends the resulting byte count. Combined with three uint16 values per emitted zero-tag record, it proves a 5461-record bound for that emitted subset; it does not bound the tree+0x20 total node count. The byte sequence is unique in .text for the governed common corpus.

entries.name: AUTOMAP_LoadSerializedCell_RestoredTagWitness
entries.notes: Within the native automap sidecar loader, the exact sequence at 0xD5C3E..0xD5C75 copies serialized frame/X/Y into a 12-byte AutomapCellKey, writes uint16 tag 1 at key+0x00, and calls AUTOMAP_InsertCell 0xD1460. This proves tag-1 keys are the native representation of restored cells accepted by the ordinary renderer tree, while AUTOMAP_SerializeCellTree later skips their nonzero low tag byte.

entries.name: AUTOMAP_CurrentLayerOwner
entries.notes: Pointer to D2R's currently active 0xB0-byte automap layer owner. The governed witness at 0xD541E compares a candidate owner against this exact global and enters the destructive 0xD1710 switch path when they differ; 0xD1710 then reads the same global before serializing and freeing its four trees. MapSense reads this pointer only on D2R's UI thread after exact byte/layout witnesses, requires owner+0x00 to equal the current level's authoritative Levels.Layer, never writes or switches it and never retains it beyond one bounded pump.

entries.name: AUTOMAP_RevealActiveRoom
entries.notes: Reveals one ActiveRoom into a supplied layer owner with observed ABI (uint8 dataContext, ActiveRoom*, int32 revealEntireRoom, AutomapLayerOwner*) -> void. It sends the 0x48-stride floor and wall tile arrays to AUTOMAP_BuildTileCell using owner+0x08 and owner+0x30, then sends admissible object units to owner+0x58. Its only direct caller is the standard callback 0xD2240 and its strict 32-byte entry signature is unique.

entries.name: AUTOMAP_ProjectClientCoordinatesToScreen
entries.notes: Projects packed client/dimetric X/Y into the native automap context's screen-coordinate system with observed ABI (AutomapContext*, packedXYOut*, packedClientXY) -> packedXYOut*. AUTOMAP_RenderUnit supplies the coordinates returned by 0x34AF60/0x34AFB0, whose active-path reads are Path+0x08/+0x0C. World subtiles at Path+0x10/+0x14 must first be converted by 0x334E00. The caller at 0xD7750 clips the result against context+0x18/+0x1C/+0x20/+0x24. Its strict 32-byte entry signature is unique in the governed corpus common to D2R 3.2.92777 and 3.3.93847.

entries.name: AUTOMAP_RenderUnit
entries.notes: Per-unit native automap renderer with observed ABI (Unit*, AutomapContext*) -> void. It resolves client/dimetric unit coordinates through 0x34AF60/0x34AFB0, projects them through 0xD4910, applies the native context clip and draws the unit icon. The strict 32-byte entry signature is unique. MapSense calls the original exactly once before its bounded observation and stores no D2R pointer outside the hook. No competing owner was found in the pinned eezstreet PluginPack.

entries.name: UNITS_GetUnitMode
entries.notes: Returns the 32-bit mode at Unit+0x0C, or zero for a null unit. Its strict 43-byte entry signature includes both the guarded null path and the non-null field read and is unique in the governed corpus. MapSense uses it to reject monster death mode 0 and dead mode 12; those mode meanings remain subject to the gameplay witness.

entries.name: UNITS_GetClientCoordX
entries.notes: Returns the current integer client/dimetric X coordinate for a Unit from the applicable static or dynamic Path. AUTOMAP_RenderUnit calls it immediately before 0x34AFB0 and AUTOMAP_ProjectClientCoordinatesToScreen. Its strict 32-byte entry signature is unique in the governed corpus. MapSense 0.9.8 uses this value unchanged for the active waypoint Unit instead of reprojecting its generation preset.

entries.name: UNITS_GetClientCoordY
entries.notes: Returns the current integer client/dimetric Y coordinate for a Unit from the applicable static or dynamic Path. AUTOMAP_RenderUnit calls it after 0x34AF60 and before AUTOMAP_ProjectClientCoordinatesToScreen. Its strict 32-byte entry signature is unique in the governed corpus. MapSense 0.9.8 uses this value unchanged for the active waypoint Unit instead of reprojecting its generation preset.

entries.name: PATH_ConvertSubtileToClientCoordinates
entries.notes: In-place integer conversion (subtileX*, subtileY*) -> client/dimetric coordinates. Its governed body computes clientX = 16 * (subtileX - subtileY) and clientY = 8 * (subtileX + subtileY). MapSense 0.9.8 reproduces this checked arithmetic for immutable subtile destinations, while active waypoint Units retain their authoritative native client pair unchanged.

entries.name: COORD_ConvertGameTileToSubtile
entries.notes: In-place integer conversion multiplying both game-tile coordinates by five. MapSense uses the proven scale in checked local arithmetic for preset validation and collision-grid geometry.

entries.name: DUNGEON_GetCollisionGridFromRoom
entries.notes: Confirmed-static one-argument ActiveRoom collision-grid accessor. It returns ActiveRoom+0x38; its strict 32-byte signature is unique in the governed common corpus. The independent witnesses at 0x36697B and 0x3669E6 prove the grid fields used by MapSense 0.9.8: origin X/Y at +0/+4, width/height at +8/+0x0C and uint16 cell pointer at +0x20.

entries.name: DRLGLEVEL_GetVisArray
entries.notes: Pure wrapper with observed ABI (uint8 dataContext, Level*) -> int32_t* that loads Level+0x1F8 and Level+0x1C8, then delegates to 0x360800. The core returns the dynamic Drlg+0x118 node's Vis[8] array at +0x04 when present, otherwise LevelsTxt+0x48. Its strict 19-byte body is fingerprinted by MapSense 0.9.8.

entries.name: DRLGLEVEL_GetWarpId
entries.notes: Read-only accessor with observed ABI (uint8 dataContext, Level*, uint8 slot) -> int32. It returns Warp[slot] from the dynamic Drlg+0x118 node at +0x24 when present, otherwise LevelsTxt+0x68. MapSense 0.9.8 accepts only reciprocal direct-outdoor links whose source and target Warp values are -1.

entries.name: DRLGROOM_LinkDirectOutdoorRooms
entries.notes: Native mutating room-linker used as a semantic/layout witness only. For Warp=-1 it requires the target room reciprocal visibility bit 1 << (slot+4) and accepts source/target rectangles only when the computed gap is below six game tiles on both axes, then inserts into the source near-room vector through 0x3612E0. MapSense 0.9.8 uses the read-only reciprocal topology only to select candidate room pairs, then derives the endpoint from an already-active source collision grid; it never calls this mutating function.

entries.name: PATH_PlayerCollisionMaskWitness
entries.notes: Unique 61-byte native witness that passes collision mask 0x1C09 while evaluating a player path. The mask combines WALL 0x0001, NOPLAYER 0x0008, OBJECT 0x0400, DOOR 0x0800 and NO_PATH 0x1000. MapSense 0.12.3 fingerprints this exact witness and accepts an outdoor seam only when the edge and one interior subtile on both linked rooms are open under the complete player-path mask.

entries.name: DRLGOUTDOORS_MonasteryGateAnchorWitness
entries.notes: Unique 60-byte native witness inside the outdoor path builder. For adjacent LevelId 26 it reads the target Level game-tile origin at +0x24/+0x28 and emits the fixed Monastery Gate anchor (originX+27, originY+13). MapSense 0.12.3 fingerprints the complete sequence and uses this native anchor for Tamoe Highland to Monastery Gate instead of selecting a collision opening on the decorative facade.

entries.name: DRLGROOM_sFillLocationNegativeIndexLogCall
entries.notes: Unique five-byte CALL rel32 E8 60 FC 63 00 reached only by the guarded negative-index branch inside sFillLocation. The branch already skips the fill operation and rejoins at 0x3E1FD8 after logging, so NOPing this CALL suppresses only the repeated native diagnostic without enabling an out-of-bounds access or changing room materialization. A fresh 3.3.93847 runtime trace confirms generalized hits through MapSense collision-grid activation, while waypoint and Reveal paths can legitimately activate rooms as well.

entries.name: MonsterDataRankFlagsWitness
entries.notes: Unique 27-byte native witness that verifies unit type 1, loads MonsterData* from Unit+0x10 and tests rank flags at MonsterData+0x1A with mask 0x0E. This proves the super-unique, champion and unique flag group used by MapSense. The separate minion bit 0x10 remains historically corroborated rather than proven by this exact witness, so rejecting it from the normal category is conservative.

entries.name: UI_CalculateIncomingHitChance
entries.notes: Character Screen defensive hit-chance calculator. Its single direct caller at 0x14E8242 retains the EAX result in EBX and passes it as ECX to UI_FormatIncomingHitChanceTooltip at 0x14E8262. The function computes the raw monster-versus-player chance and returns without a terminal 5%-95% clamp; the remaining vanilla clamp is owned by the formatter.

entries.name: UI_FormatIncomingHitChanceTooltip
entries.notes: Character Screen formatter called only from 0x14E8262 with the calculated chance in ECX and the output string in RDX. It clamps the incoming value in the unique 18-byte sequence at 0x1514CBD, then formats localization id 10104 charmontohit1X or 10105 charmontohit2X. This is the post-calculation clamp omitted by the original seven-write Hit Chance Bounds patch.

entries.name: UI_IncomingHitChanceLowerBoundOperand
entries.notes: Immediate byte 05 in CMP ECX,5 at 0x1514CBD inside UI_FormatIncomingHitChanceTooltip. The containing sequence 83 F9 05 7D 07 BF 05 00 00 00 EB 0A B8 5F 00 00 00 is unique in the governed build-92777 corpus reused for D2R 3.3.93847. Hit Chance Bounds writes 00 so valid non-negative calculated chances can reach 0%.

entries.name: UI_IncomingHitChanceUpperBoundOperand
entries.notes: Four-byte immediate 5F 00 00 00 in MOV EAX,95 at 0x1514CC9 inside UI_FormatIncomingHitChanceTooltip. It shares the unique governed clamp sequence beginning at 0x1514CBD. Hit Chance Bounds writes 64 00 00 00 so the defensive Character Screen formatter uses the same 100% ceiling as the gameplay and offensive display paths.

entries.name: AITHINK_ShadowMaster
entries.notes: Modern Shadow Warrior/Shadow Master AI handler for D2R 3.3.93847. The native flow obtains the minion owner and owner target, validates it, preserves the squared-distance 144 owner leash, enumerates targets through the callback at 0x5D1360, applies the non-combat owner-relative selection chain and keeps the squared-distance 1024 fallback. Its strict 32-byte entry signature is unique in the governed corpus. D2MOO is semantic 1.10f evidence only; the current runtime-initialized AI table mapping remains a gameplay validation gate.

entries.name: AITHINK_TargetCallback_ShadowMaster
entries.notes: Target-enumeration callback passed by AITHINK_ShadowMaster at 0x5CDD00 to the native enumerator called at 0x5CDD4B. It rejects the acting unit and dead or invalid candidates, then maintains owner-relative, minion-relative and killable-target selections in the callback argument. Its strict 32-byte entry signature is unique in the governed corpus.

entries.name: ShadowMasterOwnerTargetOverrideGate
entries.notes: Two-byte JE +0x25 (74 25) after the owner-target null check. The skipped block validates the owner's target and assigns it to the Shadow's active target at 0x5CDBD3; the branch destination keeps the native owner-distance and catch-up path. Shadow Master AI Fix writes EB 25. The strict 16-byte context E8 73 22 EC FF 48 8B D8 48 85 C0 74 25 48 8B C8 is unique in the governed D2R 3.3.93847 corpus.

entries.name: ShadowMasterOwnerCenteredReselectionGate
entries.notes: Two-byte JNE +0x74 (75 74) following the combat-state comparison after target enumeration. The fallthrough non-combat block prioritizes the owner's target, then the owner-relative callback candidate and a bounded fallback. Shadow Master AI Fix writes EB 74 so the Shadow keeps its independently acquired target. The strict 16-byte context 83 7C 24 68 00 75 74 48 85 DB 74 05 4C 8B EB EB is unique in the governed D2R 3.3.93847 corpus.

entries.name: SKILLS_SrvDo049_ApplyShadowSummonBonuses
entries.notes: Current D2R 3.3.93847 helper called after Shadow Warrior/Master summon creation. At 0x56D796 it compares the skill level with 1 and branches only when less than 1, so level 1 is accepted. It advances six AuraStat/AuraStatCalc pairs from record offsets +0x74/+0x88 and fourteen PassiveStat/PassiveCalc pairs from +0xBA/+0xD8. This proves both legacy SrvDoFunc 49 bugs are already fixed and no memory patch is warranted. Its strict 32-byte entry signature is unique in the governed corpus.

entries.name: SKILLS_ValidateReviveTarget
entries.notes: Shared server validator called by SKILLS_SrvDo058_Revive at 0x55E8EC and reached by SKILLS_SrvSt21_Revive at 0x5604A8. Observed ABI is int32 (game, caster, target). It requires a monster with the MonStats2 Revive flag, a dead consumable corpse and AIUTIL_CanUnitSwitchAi(target,true,true,true,true). Its strict 32-byte entry signature is unique in the governed build-92777 corpus reused for current D2R 3.3.93847.

entries.name: SKILLS_SrvDo058_Revive
entries.notes: Authoritative server Revive handler with observed ABI int32 (game, caster, skillId, skillLevel). It resolves the target at 0x55E8D2, calls the shared validator at 0x55E8EC and invokes the revive transformation helper at 0x55E91B. The helper clears an existing right active skill through SKILLS_SetRightActiveSkill(target,0,-1). Revive Overhaul wraps this entry and, only after a successful result, reactivates the exact captured Aura Enchanted tuple through D2GAME_AssignSkill. Its strict 38-byte entry signature is unique.

entries.name: CLIENT_ValidateReviveTarget
entries.notes: Client Revive corpse-selection predicate with observed ABI bool (caster, target). It requires a consumable corpse, then calls AIUTIL_CanUnitSwitchAi(target,true,true,true,true) at 0x96648 before preserving the remaining native monster and class restrictions. The strict 32-byte entry and the exact AI-gate call sequence are each unique in the governed common corpus. Revive Overhaul does not hook this entry; version 2.1.2 owns only its direct AI-gate CALL at 0x96648.

entries.name: CLIENT_ReviveTargetAiGateCall
entries.notes: Unique 24-byte argument-and-call witness for CLIENT_ValidateReviveTarget invoking AIUTIL_CanUnitSwitchAi with all four optional gates enabled. The direct five-byte CALL begins at 0x96648 and returns at 0x9664D. The original predicate enforces state, mode, boss/prime-evil and SwitchAI safety, and the client selector continues through every later native restriction.

entries.name: CLIENT_ReviveTargetAiGateDirectCall
entries.source: Mission/revive-overhaul-2.1.md; addons/ReviveOverhaul/NATIVE-CONTRACT.md; direct governed common-corpus disassembly
entries.notes: Exact five-byte direct CALL E8 E3 60 2B 00 from CLIENT_ValidateReviveTarget to AIUTIL_CanUnitSwitchAi, returning at 0x9664D. Revive Overhaul 2.1.2 owns this callsite through managed PatchCallRel32 and a nearby relay. The relay changes only checkUnique for rank mask 0x000E; the shared callee entry and every later selector restriction remain native.

entries.name: SKILLS_ReviveNativeMarkerWitness
entries.notes: Unique 43-byte native Revive witness. After owner and AI-event setup it enables unit flag 0x80000000 through 0x34E190, then calls STATES_ToggleState(monster,96,true) at 0x55EB6E. This independently proves state 96 as the native Revive marker in D2R. Revive Overhaul 2.1 uses STATES_CheckState(monster,96) to scope its leash changes without assuming pettype or AI special state 7.

entries.name: AIUTIL_CanUnitSwitchAi
entries.notes: Observed five-argument ABI bool (monster, checkState143, checkUnique, checkBoss, checkSwitchAI). It always rejects state 54 and unsafe unit modes/flags; optional gates reject state 143, rank mask Unique|SuperUnique, MonStats boss/prime-evil bits and a missing MonStats SwitchAI bit. Revive Overhaul calls this unhooked function with true,false,true,true for its server fallback and through its owned client callsite relay at 0x96648; all other callers remain native.

entries.name: MONSTERUNIQUE_CheckMonsterTypeFlag
entries.notes: Observed ABI bool (monster, uint16 mask). It validates a monster Unit and tests the rank flags stored in MonsterData. Revive Overhaul uses mask 0x000E to confine its fallback to Champion, SuperUnique and Unique targets. Its strict 31-byte entry signature is already shared with the governed BKVCombat implementation.

entries.name: MONSTERUNIQUE_GetUMods
entries.notes: Validates a monster Unit and returns the zero-terminated MonUMod byte list at MonsterData+0x20. Revive Overhaul scans at most nine entries and identifies Aura Enchanted by exact native MonUMod id 30; no aura skill id is hardcoded. Its strict 24-byte entry signature is unique in the governed corpus.

entries.name: UNITS_GetRightSkill
entries.notes: Returns the right active skill through Unit skill-list state. The Revive transformation helper calls it before clearing the slot; Revive Overhaul captures the pre-transform skill id and owner GUID from the returned active-skill node. Its strict 32-byte entry signature is unique in the governed corpus.

entries.name: D2GAME_SKILLS_ServerDoHandler
entries.notes: Authoritative server skill do-handler with observed x64 ABI int32 (game, unit, skillId, skillLevel, consumeResources, itemCast, itemEffect). Eight direct callers prove manual executions use consumeResources=1,itemCast=0,itemEffect=0, while native item CTC uses itemCast=1. The function resolves the context-aware SkillsTxt row, executes its SrvDo handler and returns nonzero only on success. Cast Triggers wraps the unique strict 32-byte entry and separately verifies the unique 27-byte witness at 0x43ACEC encoding game+0x106 and the call to DATATBLS_GetSkillsTxtRecordForContext before dispatching doactive; D2MOO is semantic evidence only.

entries.name: D2GAME_ApplyUnitStatEvent
entries.notes: Safe wrapper with observed ABI int32 (game, eventId, sourceUnit, targetUnit, damage). It constructs the native event context, accepts a null damage pointer and calls D2GAME_DispatchUnitStatEventList at 0x5881E0. Cast Triggers invokes it with event 4 doactive after a successful eligible cast. Its strict 18-byte entry signature is unique in the governed corpus reused for current D2R 3.3.93847.

entries.name: DATATBLS_GetSkillsTxtRecordForContext
entries.notes: Context-aware SkillsTxt lookup with observed ABI (uint8 dataContext, int32 skillId) -> compiled record pointer. It resolves the per-context table at +0x11B0/+0x11B8 and multiplies the validated row index by the proven 0x2EC record stride at 0x9780B. Cast Triggers reads the flags QWORD at +0x24, player animation at +0x30 and sequence transition at +0x32. Its strict 40-byte entry signature and separate 12-byte stride witness at 0x9780B are each unique and belong to the versionless native fingerprint.

entries.name: SKILLITEM_CastOnTarget
entries.notes: Native item-skill caster for a unit target with observed ABI int32 (caster, skillId, skillLevel, target, flag). EventFunc20 calls it at 0x583C7F for ItemTgtDo with flag 0 and at 0x583CB4 for ordinary unit targeting with flag 1. Cast Triggers wraps the unique strict 45-byte entry, substitutes only its reserved positive same-level marker, and reroutes only its synthetic ordinary self target. A unit actually returned to the eligible source handler is passed through this original route; a consumed position uses SKILLITEM_CastAtPosition, while self/none preserves the original call. ItemTgtDo flag 0 remains native. The dispatch context is suspended during the proc so nested casts cannot inherit source state. The PluginPack Whirlwind CTC patch is later in the original body at 0x589736 and does not overlap this entry ownership.

entries.name: SKILLITEM_CastAtPosition
entries.notes: Native item-skill position caster with observed ABI int32 (caster, skillId, skillLevel, x, y, flag). EventFunc20 calls it at 0x583CE1 when no unit target is selected. Cast Triggers wraps the unique strict 43-byte entry and applies the same reserved positive same-level substitution and recursion suspension as the target path. Its target hook invokes this original trampoline exactly once only when the eligible source handler consumed a complete paired first-point X/Y descriptor. The PluginPack state patch at 0x58986B is inside the original body and does not overlap entry ownership.

entries.name: SUNIT_GetTargetUnit
entries.notes: Resolves the current server target with observed ABI (game, sourceUnit) -> targetUnit. Revive Overhaul calls it before the native Revive handler. Cast Triggers owns the entry as a thread-local observer: only calls made for the eligible source unit while its native handler runs update the consumed descriptor. A returned unit wins; a later null result permits a paired first-point position; no call remains self/none. Its strict 30-byte entry signature is unique in the governed corpus, and no governed Suite or pinned PluginPack source owns a competing hook.

entries.name: D2GAME_PlayerSkillUnitInputExecutor
entries.notes: Common authoritative server executor for player skill actions addressed to a unit, including the hold-action wrappers. Its observed ABI is int32 (game, player, targetType, targetGuid, activeSkill, argument6, argument7). It resolves the packet's exact target through SUNIT_GetServerUnit at 0x48FE80 and synchronously finalizes the player mode, but 3.3.93847 diagnostics prove the central do-handler consumes the cast after this executor returns. Cast Triggers wraps the unique strict 28-byte entry and persists the exact unit identity in a bounded per-player record until the matching successful handler consumes it.

entries.name: D2GAME_PlayerSkillPositionInputExecutor
entries.notes: Common authoritative server executor for player skill actions addressed to a ground position, including Shift and hold-action wrappers. Its observed ABI is int32 (game, player, x, y, argument, activeSkill). It carries the packet's exact X/Y through synchronous player-mode finalization, but 3.3.93847 diagnostics prove the central do-handler consumes the cast after this executor returns. Cast Triggers wraps the unique strict 36-byte entry and persists the exact position in a bounded per-player record until the matching successful handler consumes it.

entries.name: SKILLS_ActiveSkillRecordLayoutWitness
entries.notes: The strict 24-byte entry reads ActiveSkill+0x00 as the compiled SkillsTxt pointer and compares the record word at +0x00 before reading another active-skill field. Cast Triggers fingerprints this sequence before reading the same pointer and unsigned skill ID word to associate a persisted player input with the later central do-handler. The exact witness is shared by governed builds 92777 and 93847.

entries.name: UNITS_GetDynamicPath
entries.notes: Observed ABI DynamicPath* (Unit*). Its unique strict 68-byte body validates the unit and returns Unit+0x38. Cast Triggers calls and fingerprints it before the eligible source handler, then uses the exact returned pointer only to filter lower PATH_GetFirstPointX/Y observations to the source player's DynamicPath. It is not hooked and its coordinates are not sampled directly.

entries.name: PATH_GetFirstPointX
entries.notes: Observed ABI int32 (DynamicPath*). Its strict 16-byte entry returns the unsigned first-point X word at path+0x10. The governed corpus has 29 direct xrefs; UNITS_GetPathFirstPointX tail-jumps here, while Chain Lightning's ground-target path calls this lower accessor directly and therefore bypasses the wrapper. Cast Triggers owns this entry as a TLS observer and records X only for the exact source-player DynamicPath captured before the eligible native handler.

entries.name: PATH_GetFirstPointY
entries.notes: Observed ABI int32 (DynamicPath*). Its strict 16-byte entry returns the unsigned first-point Y word at path+0x12. The governed corpus has 26 direct xrefs; UNITS_GetPathFirstPointY tail-jumps here, while Chain Lightning's ground-target path calls this lower accessor directly and therefore bypasses the wrapper. Cast Triggers owns this entry as a TLS observer and records Y only for the exact source-player DynamicPath captured before the eligible native handler; a paired X/Y observation becomes the native position descriptor.

entries.name: PATH_GetX
entries.notes: Observed ABI int32 (DynamicPath*). The unique strict 16-byte entry returns the unsigned current X word at path+0x02. D2R callers pair it with PATH_GetY when serializing or consuming a dynamic unit position. The rejected Cast Triggers coordinate-equality candidate used it; the consumed-target candidate no longer calls, hooks or fingerprints this surface.

entries.name: PATH_GetY
entries.notes: Observed ABI int32 (DynamicPath*). The unique strict 16-byte entry returns the unsigned current Y word at path+0x06. D2R callers pair it with PATH_GetX when serializing or consuming a dynamic unit position. The rejected Cast Triggers coordinate-equality candidate used it; the consumed-target candidate no longer calls, hooks or fingerprints this surface.

entries.name: PATH_GetDirection
entries.notes: Observed ABI uint8 (DynamicPath*). The unique strict 16-byte entry returns the raw direction byte at path+0xBD; a D2R caller at 0x47B1F0 serializes it beside current path coordinates. Runtime diagnostics observed value 73 before and after differently aimed Chain Lightning casts, and both setter candidates failed rapid-turn gameplay. The D2MOO 0..63 domain and both D2R sampling timings are rejected as Cast Triggers facing contracts; this surface is no longer used or fingerprinted by the plugin.

entries.name: PATH_SetDirection
entries.notes: Observed ABI void (DynamicPath*, uint8). Its unique exact 34-byte body returns on null, clamps values greater than or equal to 0x4D to 0x4D, then writes the resulting raw D2R direction to both path+0xBD and path+0xBC. Twenty native callsites reference it. Pre- and post-handler Cast Triggers candidates both failed rapid-turn gameplay, so the plugin no longer calls, hooks or fingerprints this setter.

entries.name: UNITS_GetPathFirstPointX
entries.notes: Observed ABI int32 (Unit*). For ordinary dynamic units it resolves Unit+0x38 and tail-jumps at 0x34B933 to PATH_GetFirstPointX 0x341CC0. EventFunc20 calls this wrapper at 0x583CC5 immediately before its no-unit-target position cast. Runtime evidence proved Chain Lightning's Shift-ground path bypasses the wrapper, so Cast Triggers no longer hooks or fingerprints this entry; it observes the governed lower accessor instead.

entries.name: UNITS_GetPathFirstPointY
entries.notes: Observed ABI int32 (Unit*). For ordinary dynamic units it resolves Unit+0x38 and tail-jumps at 0x34B983 to PATH_GetFirstPointY 0x341CD0. EventFunc20 calls this wrapper at 0x583CBB immediately before its no-unit-target position cast. Runtime evidence proved Chain Lightning's Shift-ground path bypasses the wrapper, so Cast Triggers no longer hooks or fingerprints this entry; it observes the governed lower accessor instead.

entries.name: UNITS_GetUnitType
entries.notes: Returns Unit+0x00 for a non-null Unit and the native invalid unit type 6 for null. Cast Triggers requires type 0 player before dispatching doactive. Its strict 32-byte entry signature is unique in the governed corpus.

entries.name: SKILLS_GetSeqNumFromSkill
entries.notes: Current D2R 3.3.93847 sequence selector. The player path reads the compiled SkillsTxt seqnum byte at +0x33 at 0x33DC42; the monster path remains distinct. Entry bytes and control flow are verified in the governed image whose useful native identity is shared with the current retail target.

entries.name: DATATBLS_GetSeqRecordFromUnit
entries.notes: Resolves a player sequence descriptor from seqnum, player mode and weapon class, then addresses six-byte animation sequence records. The 24-byte descriptor stride is proven at 0x3CB987 by the 3*8 index construction. Runtime capture and static-image byte witnesses agree for D2R 3.3.93847.

entries.name: DATATBLS_PlayerWeaponsSequenceTable
entries.notes: Runtime BSS pointer table indexed by seqnum. Slot 0 is null and slots 1 through 25 route to 14-descriptor groups; current groups 24 and 25 are Cleave and Mirrored Blades. All captured descriptor and record bytes cross-match governed static-image seeds.

entries.name: DATATBLS_PlayerWeaponClassMap
entries.notes: Runtime map for the 14 player weapon-animation classes consumed by DATATBLS_GetSeqRecordFromUnit. The captured bytes match the unique static seed at RVA 0x19EAF70 exactly.

entries.name: DATATBLS_PlayerWeaponClassMap_StaticSeed
entries.notes: Unique governed-image seed for the 14-byte player weapon-class routing map copied to runtime RVA 0x2386730. Exact bytes are verified by the deterministic extractor against the D2R 3.3.93847 capture.

entries.name: D2GAME_SERVER_HandleWeaponSwap
entries.notes: Authoritative server handler with observed x64 ABI (game, player, packet, packetSize) -> int32. It requires exactly 30 bytes and routes the native weapon-set transition through the shared item-state batch at 0x471E90. Gear Swap Inventory observes this seam after the player's normal input mapping has already produced the vanilla request, preserving remapped weapon-swap bindings without owning UI_DispatchMessage.

entries.name: ITEMS_WriteBodyLocFourBitCallSite
entries.notes: Unique witness BA 0F 00 00 00 85 C0 8B CE 41 B8 04 00 00 00 0F 45 C8 3B CA 0F 42 D1 49 8B CE E8 BA EB 69 00. The path loads ItemData+0x54, clamps the BodyLoc to 15 and writes exactly four bits. Gear Swap must preserve 0..12 and encode memory BodyLoc 13..20 as sentinel 15 plus a three-bit extension.

entries.name: ITEMS_ReadBodyLocFourBitCallSite_A
entries.notes: Unique witness BA 04 00 00 00 E8 BF 34 6A 00 44 8B F0 48 85 FF. Reads the four-bit BodyLoc and later stores it at ItemData+0x54. The experimental decoder consumes three additional bits only for sentinel 15.

entries.name: ITEMS_ReadBodyLocFourBitCallSite_B
entries.notes: Unique witness B8 04 00 00 00 F7 C1 FD FF FF FF 48 8B CE 0F 84 ?? ?? ?? ?? 8B D0 E8 ?? ?? ?? ??. Second four-bit BodyLoc reader that later stores at ItemData+0x54; it requires the same sentinel-aware decoder as path A.

entries.name: INVENTORY_GetItemFromBodyLoc
entries.notes: Unique prologue 48 89 5C 24 10 57 48 83 EC 20 48 63 FA 48 8B D9 48 85 C9 75 20. The function guards BodyLoc <= 12 before resolving and indexing the body occupancy grid; Gear Swap requires an exact guarded extension to <=20.

entries.name: INVENTORY_PlaceItemInBodyLoc
entries.notes: Unique prologue 48 89 5C 24 10 48 89 74 24 18 57 48 83 EC 40 41 8B D8 48 8B F2 48 8B F9. The function performs two BodyLoc <= 12 guards before calling the general occupancy placement routine; Gear Swap requires both guards to accept <=20.

entries.name: INVENTORY_ResolveOccupancyGrid
entries.notes: Unique prologue 4C 8B DC 49 89 5B 20 57 48 83 EC 30 49 8B F8 48 39 51 28. On first use it copies descriptor width/height and allocates width*height pointers; later calls validate the stored dimensions. The body descriptor must be verified and expanded before any player grid is created.

entries.name: INVENTORY_PlayerBodyGridDescriptor
entries.notes: Runtime BSS descriptor referenced by body-grid resolution paths. The 93847 mod-local probe observed exact startup bytes 0D 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 before character creation. Gear Swap fails closed unless it observes exactly 13x1 before changing the width to 21; the separate 92777 runtime probe remains required.

entries.name: DATATBLS_ItemStatCostStatLinkerDescriptor
entries.notes: Unique ItemStatCost compiler witness. The first 32-byte compile descriptor stores type 0x11 at descriptor+0x08, compiled-record destination offset 0 at +0x10 and &DataTables+0x1270 at +0x18. This binds the compiled Stat name-to-index linker to record ordinal/ID offset 0 before the 0x144-byte records are built.

entries.name: LINKER_Allocate
entries.notes: Generic TXT linker allocator with 52 direct callers. It allocates a 0x40-byte object, initializes the embedded name hash at +0x18, zeros its storage/count fields and sets the invalid-index fallback at +0x3C to -1. ItemStatCost calls it at 0x31EC0D.

entries.name: LINKER_Destroy
entries.notes: Generic TXT linker destructor with 52 indexed xrefs, including direct calls and tail branches. It is null-safe, destroys the embedded name hash at linker+0x18, releases separately owned code-vector storage when present, then frees the 0x40-byte linker object. ItemStatCost calls it from the unique teardown block at 0x313ACE.

entries.name: DATATBLS_ItemStatCostStatLinkerPublish
entries.notes: Unique call/store sequence inside DATATBLS_CompileItemStatCostTxt. It calls LINKER_Allocate 0xA11FA0 and immediately stores the returned linker through RBX, previously proven as &DataTables+0x1270. The generic 0x144-byte ItemStatCost compilation call follows at 0x31EC89 and completes before the ISC12 loader seam at 0x31F0AB.

entries.name: LINKER_GetNameCount
entries.notes: Observed Windows x64 ABI uint64 (linker*). The complete 13-byte body is unique and returns linker+0x28, or zero for null. Native code at 0x2FB0F2 uses this count as the exclusive upper bound while enumerating names through LINKER_GetNameByIndex.

entries.name: LINKER_GetNameByIndex
entries.notes: Observed Windows x64 ABI const char* (linker*, int32 index, int32 mode), with native callers passing mode 0 or 1; the current body does not consume R8. It rejects null, negative and out-of-range indices, walks the embedded name hash at linker+0x18, matches node+0x30 to the requested index and returns the linker-owned NUL-terminated bytes at node+0x08. Invalid or missing indices return the engine empty-string pointer.

entries.name: DATATBLS_ItemStatCostNameLookupWitness
entries.notes: Unique ItemStatCost consumer witness. After GetDataTablesForContext, it loads RCX from DataTables+0x1270, sign-extends the 16-bit stat ID into EDX and passes zero in R8D to LINKER_GetNameByIndex, then scans the returned bytes to NUL and copies them. Other consumers at 0x169A36 and 0x1D26CD reuse the same ID both for name lookup and for record base + ID*0x144, proving index-to-compiled-ordinal identity.

entries.name: DATATBLS_ItemStatCostStatLinkerTeardown
entries.notes: Unique ItemStatCost teardown sequence. After the owner zeros DataTables+0x1260 and releases the record vector at +0x1258, it loads the linker from DataTables+0x1270, conditionally destroys it through LINKER_Destroy 0xA12000 and then zeros the slot at 0x313AE6. Names returned by LINKER_GetNameByIndex are therefore linker-owned and must be copied before teardown or reload.

entries.name: SAVEOBJECT_GetNameSubobject
entries.notes: Complete exact unique body returns RCX+0x20. The unique 0x9F6FE0 witness proves pointer bytes at subobject+0 and explicit uint64 length at +8; ISC12 copies and bounds both before classification.

entries.name: SAVEOBJECT_NamePointerLengthWitness
entries.notes: Unique comparison block calls SAVEOBJECT_GetNameSubobject for two objects, then reads the returned pointer at +0 and uint64 byte length at +8.

entries.name: SAVEOBJECT_WriterBufferLayoutWitness
entries.notes: Unique writer block calls the shared +0x10 qword accessor, loads the whole-buffer pointer at object+8, narrows the size to DWORD in R8D and passes both to the physical write wrapper.

entries.name: SAVEOBJECT_ResizeByteBuffer
entries.notes: Exact unique thunk adds 8 to the save-object pointer and tail-jumps to the byte-vector resize body at 0xEDC40. The adjacent 0xA1E200 body writes DWORD state at object+0x58.

entries.name: SAVEOBJECT_ByteBufferResizeBody
entries.notes: Long exact unique body prefix for the vector-resize implementation reached by SAVEOBJECT_ResizeByteBuffer; governs the allocation/lifetime target rather than trusting only the thunk displacement.

entries.name: SAVEOBJECT_SetAux
entries.notes: Complete exact unique body writes RDX to save-object+0x60 and returns. Used by reader rejection cleanup and native committed bookkeeping.

entries.name: SAVEOBJECT_BuildTimestamp
entries.notes: Exact unique timestamp helper called first by the writer committed continuation at 0x9F95E9. ISC12 deliberately leaves timestamp publication native-owned.

entries.name: SAVEOBJECT_LockThunk
entries.notes: Exact unique import thunk called immediately before both governed physical reader/writer seams; paired with unlock thunk 0x1234110.

entries.name: SAVEOBJECT_UnlockThunk
entries.notes: Exact unique import thunk reached by every selected reader/writer committed or rejected continuation; paired with lock thunk 0x1234100.

entries.name: FILES_Utf8PathConversionWitness
entries.notes: Unique MultiByteToWideChar call context proves CP_UTF8, flags 0 and input length -1 for the native save path; the ISC12 adapter mirrors these exact semantics into owned UTF-16 storage.

entries.name: FILES_ReadPhysicalStore
entries.notes: Complete exact unique body performs a DWORD ReadFile, stores actual bytes through R9, and returns the current success-code cell at 0x1E9C0E8 on success or broken pipe.

entries.name: FILES_NativeIoSuccessCode
entries.notes: BSS success-code cell returned by FILES_ReadPhysicalStore. All 40 indexed RIP xrefs are reads and no address escapes; ISC12 range-validates and SafeReads the current value on every target reader callback rather than caching it.

entries.name: FILES_NativeIoSuccessComparisonWitness
entries.notes: Exact unique call/compare block independently compares another native file-wrapper result against the same 0x1E9C0E8 success-code cell.

entries.name: FILES_InitializeHandle
entries.notes: Complete exact unique body writes INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE to the handle slot and returns RCX; replayed by the future writer midhook before native continuation dispatch.

entries.name: FILES_CloseHandle
entries.notes: Complete exact unique body skips CloseHandle when the slot is -1 and otherwise closes then resets it to -1, proving the selected writer continuations are safe after replayed initialization.

entries.name: SAVEOBJECT_PhysicalReaderEnvelopeSeam
entries.notes: Unique five-byte seam after complete physical read and before native close/state-3 publication. P3b prepares but does not install the ISC12 reader relay.

entries.name: SAVEOBJECT_PhysicalReaderRejectedContinuation
entries.notes: Exact unique native continuation selects status 6, closes, unlocks and returns without publishing state 3.

entries.name: SAVEOBJECT_PhysicalWriterTransactionSeam
entries.notes: Unique five-byte seam immediately before destructive CREATE_ALWAYS. P3b prepares but does not install the ISC12 atomic writer relay.

entries.name: SAVEOBJECT_PhysicalWriterCommittedContinuation
entries.notes: Exact unique continuation publishes timestamp, closes, sets state 3, unlocks and selects status 0 only after a proven atomic commit.

entries.name: SAVEOBJECT_PhysicalWriterRejectedContinuation
entries.notes: Exact unique continuation closes, unlocks and selects status 6 without timestamp/state publication; uncertain rollback failure must fail fast before reaching it.

entries.name: SAVEOBJECT_PhysicalWriterStatusPublish
entries.notes: Exact unique common block publishes the committed/rejected status into the scheduled object and resumes the native callback state machine.

entries.name: PLAYERSTATS_AuxFirstStatIdCodec
